```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
library(knitr)
```

{.tabset}

### 2026 {.tabset}

#### Hilary {.tabset}

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis', out.width='100%'}
include_graphics('isis_flag_history/2026_hilary_term.png')
cat(readLines('isis_flag_history/2026_hilary_term.txt'), sep = '\n')
cat('\n<br>\n')
```
